title: Multi-field search, ticket dependencies, epics (real tickets), and label system
objective: Implement the engine's query layer, relationship graph, and epic tracking — multi-field search, ticket dependencies, epics as real ticket types, and label system.

acceptance_criteria.text: Search matches across title, objective, area, and acceptance-criterion text.
Ticket dependencies and blocked_by form a queryable relationship graph.
Epics are real tickets with a composite status from their children.
Labels use validated prefix/value sets with user/* free-form values.
